selectionRationale: Live Cluster reader cursors and secure member-gated RPC already exist, so UI visibility/reconciliation is lower risk than a new receipt table. Native ad gate has stale React eligibility after lock release; subscriptions preserve existing AdMob request throttles and privacy. Versioned avatar source URL must also version Expo Image cache identity.
alternativeApproaches: Adding a duplicate Cluster-specific seen receipt table or loosening RLS is rejected: canonical authorized room cursors already exist.
Removing the 2-minute no-fill and remount request cooldown is rejected: ad request spam does not improve fill and increases platform risk.
Replacing the ad SDK or changing production ad IDs is rejected: those require native build and do not address stale mounted component eligibility.
Enabling broad public profiles Realtime without scoped authorization is rejected: this fix delivers safe instant local avatar repaint without exposing profile updates.
